description: Attach to a running Electron process that was NOT started with a debug flag, by injecting the Node inspector. Provide pid. Returns: { ok, session_id, transport, windows, capabilities }. Errors: INJECT_FAILED (handshake failed or inspector belongs to another process; retryable — try electron_attach when the app already exposes a debug endpoint), TRANSPORT_UNSUPPORTED, BAD_ARGUMENT.

pid.description: Process id of the running Electron app.

timeoutMs.description: Max wait for the inspector handshake.

name: electron_inject
title: Inject into running Electron app
